if: credit has to be attributed under s.17(1) or s.17(2)
then: the MANNER of attribution is such as the Government MAY PRESCRIBE — the Act itself supplies no formula
note: This is why no apportionment number can be produced from the Act alone. Any computed attribution must cite the prescribing Rule, which is not extracted here; from this source the formula is UNKNOWN. The source is the CGST Act as updated 31-08-2021. UNKNOWN whether a later amendment has changed this provision; later amendments are not held locally.

evidence.quote: The Government may prescribe the manner in which the credit referred to in sub-sections (1) and (2) may be attributed.
